content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Protein intake for muscle building typically ranges from 1.6–2.2 g per kg of body weight daily, depending on your training intensity and experience. Since you're targeting 100 kg bench press in three months, you're in a serious growth phase – aim for the higher end (around 2 g/kg) to support strength gains and recovery.

Split it across 4–5 meals for better absorption, prioritize whole foods (chicken, fish, eggs, dairy), and pair it with consistent training and enough calories overall. How's your current nutrition tracking looking?
